about.title: Shaping Future Champions Through the Art of Chess
about.p1: Aim Chess Academy was established with a singular mission: to empower young minds through the royal game of chess. We believe chess is more than just a game—it is a powerful tool to cultivate concentration, logical reasoning, endurance, and decisive problem-solving abilities.
about.p2: Under the mentorship of FIDE Certified Trainers and titled masters, our academy has trained hundreds of young players from India, the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Singapore, and the UAE, guiding them from basic piece movement to winning state championships and earning official FIDE ratings.
about.unique1Desc: Direct personalized instruction by international chess federation certified coaches with deep tournament experience.
about.unique2Desc: Step-by-step modular lessons from beginner fundamentals to master-level positional concepts and endgame precision.
about.unique3Desc: Monthly internal practice tournaments and active preparation for district, state, national, and international tournaments.
about.unique4Desc: Quality-controlled training standards with official ISO course completion certificates awarded to each student.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Find clear answers about demo classes, age requirements, batch timings, and certifications.

items.q: What is the age limit to join AIM Chess Academy?
items.a: We welcome students aged 5 years and above. Our courses are structured for all levels, from complete young beginners to seasoned advanced tournament players.

items.q: How can I schedule a demo session?
items.a: Scheduling a demo session is simple! Contact us via phone (+91 99034 52493), email (contact@aimchessacademy.com), or submit the online form, and we will arrange a free trial class at your convenience.

items.q: What are the timings for each course?
items.a: Course timings depend on the specific batch and skill level. We offer flexible schedules, including weekday evenings and weekend batches, accommodating both Indian and international time zones.

items.q: Are the courses suitable for complete beginners?
items.a: Absolutely! Our Beginner Course is tailored specifically for those who are brand new to chess, providing step-by-step guidance to build a solid tactical and strategic foundation.

items.q: Will I get a certificate upon completion of the course?
items.a: Yes! We provide official ISO-certified course completion certificates to all students who successfully finish their respective training levels.

items.q: What is the duration of each course?
items.a: Course durations vary depending on the level and student pace, ranging from modular monthly programs to structured multi-month master curriculums.

items.q: Are there any competitions or tournaments for students?
items.a: Yes, we organize regular monthly practice tournaments and exciting inter-academy competitions to help students apply their learning and gain invaluable tournament experience.
